question: What follows if everything is established as having the nature of the triad of powers?
premises: The triad of powers defines a fundamental nature.
Everything may be said to be established in that nature.
If so, no thing stands outside this triadic constitution.
inference: All things share the established nature of the triad of powers.
uncertainties: The specific three powers are not named in this verse.
plain_english: Where everything is established as having the nature of the triad of powers.
